label: SCG I.22 union of what is not one per se has a source
paraphrase: OPEN selected reading of SCG I.22 n.6's union-causation principle ('ea quae per se non sunt unum, si coniungantur, oportet per aliquam causam uniri'), attribution deferred: at a selected world, for every esse e joined to q, if e and q are not one per se, then the joining depends on something. Whether distinct principles can be one per se is left to the primitive perSeOne; n.6's simplicity-based step that the essence and an esse beside it are not one per se is not encoded.
